reasoningChain.evidence: Strengthening a proven output hero before the next main encounter supports the damage-led progression plan.
The berserker has delivered more than 26% damage in both observed combats and survived without dedicated healing.
The epic boots visibly list the active berserker among their highest-fit users and add rhythm and initiative.
The berserker has an empty boot slot, while the warrior already holds mythic boots; this adds the full visible gain without replacing proven gear.
